external_deps: Ollama, vLLM or SGLang (optional, for local models)

review.tagline: Terminal coding agent in Rust that works with hosted or local models
review.summary: Codewhale is a coding agent that reads a project, edits files, runs commands and checks its own work from a terminal UI. It supports over 40 built-in provider routes plus any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, Ollama, vLLM and SGLang. The same local engine also serves headless `exec` runs, a local browser client, PR review and an HTTP runtime API.
review.audience: Developers who want a terminal coding agent with a choice of model providers
strengths: Over 40 built-in provider routes plus OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Ollama, vLLM and SGLang
Plan, Work and Operate modes with Ask, Auto-Review and Full Access postures
`/undo`, `/restore` and `/receipts` recover changes and list files, commands and approvals
Headless `exec --auto` and `review --pr N` for scripts and CI
weaknesses: Usage telemetry is on by default and must be disabled with a config command
OS sandbox only on macOS (Seatbelt) and Linux with bubblewrap installed
Native desktop app is still being built; VS Code extension is community-maintained
Computer Use plugin must be reviewed and enabled manually before use
needs: Needs Ollama, vLLM or SGLang (optional, for local models), bubblewrap (optional, Linux sandbox)
Models: Anthropic, DeepSeek, Google, Mistral, Moonshot
